items.story: ഇന്ത്യൻ വിപണി ലക്ഷ്യമിട്ട് 10 ലക്ഷം രൂപയിൽ താഴെ വിലയുള്ള പുതിയ ഇലക്ട്രിക് കാർ അവതരിപ്പിക്കാൻ മാരുതി സുസുക്കി ഒരുങ്ങുന്നു. നഗരയാത്രകൾക്ക് പ്രാധാന്യം നൽകുന്ന ഈ വാഹനം, ഒറ്റ ചാർജിൽ 315 കിലോമീറ്റർ വരെ റേഞ്ച് നൽകുമെന്നാണ് പ്രതീക്ഷ. നിലവിലുള്ള കാറിന്റെ പതിപ്പല്ലാതെ, ഒരു സമർപ്പിത ഇവി പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോമിലായിരിക്കും ഇത് നിർമ്മിക്കുക.

items.teaser: Two widely used zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have effects that linger far longer than the sweet taste itself. In mi…
items.story: Two widely used zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have effects that linger far longer than the sweet taste itself. In mice, researchers found that both sweeteners altered the gut microbiome, reduced beneficial compounds produced by gut bacteria, and changed the activity of genes involved in metabolism and inflammation. Some of those changes were also detected in later generations that had never consumed the sweeteners themselves.

items.headline: Scientists discover two superconducting states hiding as one
items.teaser: Scientists have uncovered hidden complexity inside two ultrathin superconductors that seemed much simpler than they really are. Niobium d…
items.story: Scientists have uncovered hidden complexity inside two ultrathin superconductors that seemed much simpler than they really are. Niobium diselenide and tantalum disulfide appeared to have a single superconducting state, but highly sensitive measurements revealed that each actually contains two strongly interacting states working so closely together that they masquerade as one.

items.headline: Scientists challenge a 70-year-old “lizard brain” myth

items.story: A long-standing picture of brain evolution as newer, rational layers stacked on top of an ancient “lizard brain” may be deeply misleading. Researchers found that evolution instead appears to balance two competing styles of brain wiring, expanding one while shrinking the other depending on what an animal needs to survive.
